meta.description: Semantic layer — exact definitions of every KPI. The dashboard, SQL layer, reports and any LLM narration must cite these definitions.
meta.disclosure: Synthetic, seeded dataset — fully reproducible. Methods are the story.
meta.source_data: data/raw/orders.csv (12,000 orders) + data/processed/master_orders.csv (21,066 item rows, 9,933 orders)
meta.convention_note: Revenue = SUM(line_total) across ALL order statuses (project convention, pinned by tests/test_dashboard_consistency.py).

gross_margin.definition: Gross profit as a share of revenue.

completed_orders.definition: Orders with status Delivered (of 12,000 placed; 9,312 delivered).

active_customers.definition: Distinct customers with at least one order.

churn_model.definition: Leakage-free churn model: features strictly before cutoff, label = no purchase in the 180 days after cutoff.
churn_model.caveat: Honest post-leakage number; real churn models rarely score 0.9+ without leakage.

cooling_off_customers.definition: Medium churn-risk band — the win-back audience.
cooling_off_customers.caveat: Historical spend, NOT future revenue at risk.

rfm_segments.definition: RFM quintiles + K-Means into 8 named segments.

bcg_matrix.definition: Products mapped to Star / Cash Cow / Question Mark / Dog by growth and relative share.

revenue_forecast.definition: H1 2025 projection, ensemble of linear trend + Holt-Winters, bootstrap 95% CI.
revenue_forecast.caveat: Assumes trend/seasonality continues; evaluate against actuals over time.

purchase.definition: An order with status Delivered or Returned. Cancelled orders never transacted; Processing is not yet a purchase.

cohort_retention.definition: Customers grouped by first-purchase month; retention M_k = share with >=1 purchase k months after the cohort month. M0 = 100% by definition.
cohort_retention.verified_pattern: Month-1 retention rises from ~15-28% (2023 cohorts) to 55-88% (late 2024).

mom_delta.definition: Month-over-month change of a KPI (latest vs previous month). Alert threshold: 10% relative change.

clv_concentration.definition: Share of projected customer lifetime value held by the top decile.

winback_experiment.definition: DESIGN ONLY — no experiment has been run. See docs/experiment_design_winback.md.
